repair_reason: Post-baseline semantic audit found two concrete P1 discipline loopholes that static cross-layer acceptance did not prove closed.

findings.pre_repair_behavior: An existing exposure with stop_loss_breached=true could avoid EXIT_REQUIRED when adjustment_condition_satisfied=true, because the evaluator could not prove that the condition had been satisfied before the active stop was breached.
findings.repair: The active stop is authoritative. For an existing exposure, stop_loss_breached=true now always returns EXIT_REQUIRED before evidence, override, or rule-revision logic. Legitimate pre-breach stop transitions must update the active stop before evaluation; the legacy adjustment flag cannot exempt an already-breached active stop.

findings.pre_repair_behavior: The V1 packet carried only take_profit_defined and had no representation of exit-rule revision direction, exit-rule trigger state, or whether a relaxation condition was satisfied before the trigger. The engine therefore could not enforce the frozen anti-greed intent against target raising or exit-rule relaxation.
findings.repair: The active implementation now requires exit_rule_revision_type in NONE/TIGHTEN/RELAX, exit_rule_triggered, and exit_rule_relaxation_condition_satisfied_before_trigger. A triggered exit rule returns EXIT_REQUIRED. RELAX without a satisfied pre-trigger condition returns ACTION_BLOCKED_BY_RISK. TIGHTEN is risk-reducing and may remain eligible when no higher-priority rule fires.

active_semantic_supersession.stop_loss_lock: For an existing exposure, stop_loss_breached=true unconditionally means EXIT_REQUIRED. No current adjustment boolean or override can rescue the position after the active stop is breached.
active_semantic_supersession.exit_rule_trigger_lock: For an existing exposure, exit_rule_triggered=true means EXIT_REQUIRED before any requested relaxation is considered.
active_semantic_supersession.exit_rule_revision_lock: RELAX is eligible only if exit_rule_relaxation_condition_satisfied_before_trigger=true and exit_rule_triggered=false. Otherwise it is blocked by risk. TIGHTEN is treated as risk-reducing.
active_semantic_supersession.override_rule: Override remains audit-only and cannot convert any blocked or EXIT_REQUIRED state into ACTION_ELIGIBLE.

new_required_active_fields.strict_type_rule: The two new trigger/condition fields are native booleans; aliases, strings, integers and null fail closed.

regression_cases_added: stop_loss_breached=true plus legacy adjustment_condition_satisfied=true still returns EXIT_REQUIRED
exit_rule_triggered=true plus RELAX request returns EXIT_REQUIRED
RELAX without pre-trigger satisfied condition returns ACTION_BLOCKED_BY_RISK
TIGHTEN with no higher-priority trigger remains ACTION_ELIGIBLE
new enum and boolean fields fail closed on malformed values
full Decision Packet path exercises the same semantics
unchanged_guardrails: No validity threshold, sample floor, baseline or PASS-rule relaxation
